description: Research-project lifecycle hooks (chatgpt-for-researchers starter). Three hooks ship ON: reap-wolfram (kills headless Wolfram runs that finished but never exited; a no-op in projects without the script), pre-compact (stamps AGENTS.md + snapshots the task log before context compaction) and promise-checker (catches 'I've saved that' said without an actual file edit). Three more ship OFF because they need per-project configuration — enable by adding the block documented at the top of each script to a 'PostToolUse' array here: .codex/hooks/git-mirror.sh (dual-remote push mirror), .codex/hooks/pipeline-guard.sh (Pipeline workflow nudge; self-quiets until a Pipeline/ doc exists), .agents/skills/wolfram-headless/hooks/wolfram-license-notice.sh (flags the misleading wolframscript 'license error'). Codex requires every non-managed hook to be reviewed and trusted before it runs: type /hooks, inspect each script, trust it. Re-trust after editing a script.

Stop._comment: Mathematica projects only. Kills headless wolframscript jobs that FINISHED but never exited (one measured case burned 40.7 CPU-hours after its work was over, and blocked its runner so the runner's gate verdict never printed). Safe to fire every turn: it kills a job ONLY when the log already holds the script's own completion marker, so a run still computing is untouchable however long it has taken. Remember to trust it via /hooks, or it does not run.
